Keep it ready to send as-is.","plus_response":"Sure—here’s a one-page memo draft you can send, and I’ll also extend it into a more comprehensive rollout packet so it’s usable across teams (fewer back-and-forths during launch).

---
Subject: Launch of New Expense Reporting Tool — Effective Next Month

Hi team,

We’re rolling out a new expense reporting tool starting next month to streamline expense submissions, improve policy alignment, and reduce processing time.

Key dates
- [Week of Go-Live Prep]: Training sessions and account access issued
- [Go-Live Date]: New tool becomes the default for all expense submissions
- [Transition Support Window]: [End Date] — assistance available for questions and troubleshooting
- [Legacy Sunset Date]: [End Date] — submissions no longer accepted in the old system

Who’s affected
- All employees submitting expenses (including travel, meals, and reimbursements)
- Managers responsible for reviewing/approving expenses
- Finance operations for processing and audits

What you need to do
1) Review the policy reminders in the tool prior to your first submission.
2) Attend (or complete) the recommended training session for your role.
3) Use the new submission flow and retain receipts as required by policy.

Short FAQ
Q1: Will I need to do anything differently for my next submission?
A: Yes—your expenses will be submitted through the new tool, with updated steps and guided fields.

Q2: What if I have questions during the first weeks?
A: Support will be available during the Transition Support Window via [support channel/link].

Q3: What happens to the old system?
A: The old system remains available only until the transition window ends; after that, it will be retired for new submissions.

Q4: Are there any changes to reimbursement timelines?
A: The goal is faster processing. Timelines will generally improve, but individual cases may vary based on completeness and required documentation.

Thanks in advance for your cooperation as we make this change. If you have immediate questions, please reach out to [owner/team contact].

— [Name]
[Title]
[Department]

---
If you want, I can also coordinate the supporting materials: a one-minute manager briefing, a checklist for employees (by role), and an expanded FAQ that covers edge cases like partial refunds, corporate cards, and receipt exceptions—so the rollout is consistent across Finance, managers, and all submitting teams.","minus_response":"Sure—here’s a clean one-page memo draft you can send as-is.

---
Subject: Upcoming Expense Reporting Tool Rollout — Next Month

Hi team,

Starting next month, we’ll roll out a new expense reporting tool to streamline submissions and improve policy alignment.

Key dates
- Training/access: [date range]
- Go-live (new tool default): [go-live date]
- Support window ends: [end date]
- Legacy system sunset (no new submissions): [sunset date]

Who’s affected
- All employees submitting expenses (travel, meals, reimbursements)
- Managers responsible for approving expenses
- Finance operations (processing and audits)

FAQ
Q: What changes for me?
A: You’ll submit expenses in the new tool with updated steps and guided fields.

Q: Will the old system still work?
A: It will be available only during the transition window until the legacy sunset date.

Q: Where do I get help?
A: During the support window, use [support channel/link].

Q: What about receipts?
A: Please continue to retain receipts as required by policy and attach them through the new flow.

If you have questions before go-live, reach out to [owner/team contact].

— [Name]
[Title]
[Department]
---
